cases.name: Elizabeth-Faith Makanalani Fernandez
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said, "Elizabeth loved her family as she was loved by her family as well. Elizabeth worked at the Royal Kona Resort as an inspector. Elizabeth loved her job as well and worked for Supercuts as a hair technician, and stylist, and also an awesome Barber!!! This woman was invincible with love loyalty and compassion for all that surrounded and engaged with her."
